subject.title: fix: doctor upgrade 7.2-beta.1 - 7.2-beta.2 fails on fractional restart handoffs

question: Should OpenClaw accept the restart-handoff migration policy of discarding expired transient rows and flooring valid live fractional trace timestamps during upgrades to STRICT tables?
rationale: The implementation intentionally rewrites persisted shared-state values during an upgrade; correctness evidence is strong, but accepting the data-repair policy is a maintainer-owned compatibility decision.

options.title: Require a different migration policy
